lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with the largest blobs concentrated along the medial longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity cross the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern particularly visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal carina extends from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse arrangement of high-luminance spots is visible within the mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located in the anterior and central regions of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density field of small, irregular white specks is visible on the dorsal surface of the head and the proximal half of the pectoral fin.
